import ast, hashlib, importlib.util, json, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
import subprocess
p=Path('scripts/windows-native-browser-observer.py').resolve()
ast.parse(p.read_text())
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('fc_observer_local_evidence',p)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
marker='FutureClassroom-Test-TLS-'+'a'*32
manifest={'schemaVersion':1,'assets':[{'path':'index.html','sizeBytes':1,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b'x').hexdigest()}]}
with patch.object(m.subprocess,'Popen',side_effect=AssertionError('constructor must not launch')):
    o=m.BrowserObserver(SimpleNamespace(host='future-classroom-win11'),'/unused','/unused/report.json',marker,manifest,'script-src self',None,'future-classroom-win11')
assert o.report['status']=='NOT_RUN' and o.result=={}
print('PASS constructor performs no Popen; report/result initialized')
o._node_source_sha='d'*64;o.node_report=Path('/tmp/fresh-browser-node.json')
run={'generation':7,'origin':'https://localhost:12345','maxMillis':12000}
def record(path, method='GET', cache=False, wire=200):
    return {'method':method,'url':run['origin']+path,'status':200,'mime':'application/json','servedFromCache':cache,'fromDiskCache':False,'fromServiceWorker':False,'fromPrefetchCache':False,'wireStatus':wire,'finished':True,'bodyVerified':True}
content='/fc/api/v1/content/homework/1/2/3/2026-10-31'
records=[record(path) for path in ['/fc/api/v1/status','/fc/api/v1/session','/fc/api/v1/content/homework/scopes/0',content]*2]+[record(content,'POST'),record('/fc/',cache=True),record('/fc/',cache=True,wire=304)]
wires=records[:9]+records[10:]
value={'schemaVersion':1,'status':'PASS','marker':marker,**run,'sourceSha256':o._node_source_sha,'assetManifestCanonicalSha256':m.digest(m.encoded(manifest)),'expectedCspSha256':m.digest(o.expected_csp.encode()),'contextDisposed':True,'cdpDisconnected':True,'sessionCsrfMatched':True,'writeOutcome':'COMMITTED','contentPosts':1,'network':records,'wireResponses':wires,'wireResponseCount':10,'observedRequestCount':11,'observedResponseCount':11,'cacheOnlyResponseCount':1,'apiResponses':9,'pageErrorCount':0,'consoleErrorCount':0}
message={'type':'RESULT','status':'PASS','marker':marker,'wireResponseCount':10,'contentPosts':1,'contextDisposed':True,'report':str(o.node_report)}
o._validate_result(value,message,run)
print('PASS cached ExtraInfo200 excluded, 304 included; 11 observed requests -> 10 wire responses, nine API responses, one POST')
for name,change in [
    ('wireCount',{'wireResponseCount':11}),('wireRecords',{'wireResponses':records}),
    ('contextDisposal',{'contextDisposed':False}),('generation',{'generation':8}),
    ('unexpectedField',{'unexpectedPrivateField':'no'}),('observedCount',{'observedRequestCount':12}),
    ('cacheCount',{'cacheOnlyResponseCount':0}),('apiCount',{'apiResponses':8}),
    ('pageError',{'pageErrorCount':1}),('consoleError',{'consoleErrorCount':1})]:
    try:o._validate_result(dict(value,**change),message,run)
    except RuntimeError:print('PASS rejected changed '+name)
    else:raise AssertionError(change)
o._secrets=[b'private-cookie-value']
try:o._safe(b'prefix PRIVATE-COOKIE-VALUE suffix')
except RuntimeError:print('PASS private output rejected case-insensitively')
else:raise AssertionError('credential safety failed')
# Entirely fake Popen/SSH: only local synthetic report/state files exist.
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fc-observer-local-evidence-') as d:
    directory=Path(d);state=directory/'owner.control.json'
    browser_marker='FutureClassroom-Test-Browser-'+'b'*32
    state.write_text(json.dumps({'schemaVersion':1,'marker':browser_marker,'stopCapability':'f'*64,'sshTarget':'future-classroom-win11'}));state.chmod(0o600)
    o=m.BrowserObserver(SimpleNamespace(host='future-classroom-win11'),directory,directory/'main.json',marker,manifest,'csp',None,'future-classroom-win11')
    o.control_file=state;o.edge_report=directory/'owner.json'
    proc=Mock();proc.poll.return_value=None;proc.wait.side_effect=subprocess.TimeoutExpired('original-owner',215);proc.returncode=None;o.owner=proc
    o.owner_logs=SimpleNamespace(join=lambda:None,report=lambda:{'safe':'owner'})
    with patch.object(m.subprocess,'run',return_value=SimpleNamespace(returncode=1,stdout=b'',stderr=b'')) as stopped:
        try:o.close()
        except RuntimeError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('failed cleanup accepted')
    stopped.assert_called_once()
    proc.wait.assert_called_once_with(timeout=215)
    assert state.exists() and o.report['cleanup']=='FAIL' and o.report['ownerProcessRetained']
    assert len(o.report['errors'])==2
    print('PASS failed stop request still observes ORIGINAL owner; timeout preserves cap and records both failures')
    original=o.owner
    proc.poll.return_value=0;proc.returncode=0;proc.wait.side_effect=None
    o.edge_report.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','cleanup':'PASS','marker':browser_marker,'rawPreservation':{'status':'PASS'},'nativeOutcome':{'actualJobProcessesZero':True,'originalPrimaryExited':True,'originalHandlesClosed':True},'cleanupDetails':{'rootAbsent':True}}))
    o.close()
    assert o.owner is original and not state.exists() and o.report['cleanup']=='PASS'
    assert not o.report['ownerProcessRetained'] and len(o.report['errors'])==2 and o.report['status']=='FAIL'
    print('PASS reentrant close uses SAME owner; only after actual exit and physical evidence removes cap; prior failure retained')
assert not directory.exists()
o=m.BrowserObserver(SimpleNamespace(host='future-classroom-win11'),'/unused','/unused/report.json',marker,manifest,'csp',None,'future-classroom-win11')
assert o.close()['cleanup']=='PASS' and o.close()['cleanup']=='PASS'
print('PASS no-resource close is idempotent; synthetic local fixture removed')
print(json.dumps({'status':'PURE_LOCAL_PASS','remote':'NOT_RUN','windows':'NOT_RUN','mockedOwnership':'not native physical evidence','sourceSha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))
